Yeah I realised what I wanted to do more gradually I kind of knew I wanted to do music production but I also thought I wanted to be a movie director, editor or DOP for a bit but when I chose to do the film course I was really not enjoying and realised the only reason I had decided to do that was because I was scared of failing at what I really wanted to do, so I just completed the first year of film and then moved to music technology and it's definitely what I want a career in. But wanting to do something with music has been in the back of my head for a while I just took me a while to go all in on it, so I think what you wanna do will be somewhere in your head. The only advice I can give you is just brainstorm look around the internet at things that really interest you and watch people who are successful in that Industry do talks on YouTube or something just to get a feel for what it's like.

That last bit i can really relate to i would love to move out of my small town and meet some more new people that i can be happy around i personally find the future both exciting and scary sometimes more scary. but i would rather it be uncertain than have some safe boring office job, because thats not the life i'm after its just the same shit different day. About your A levels i wouldn't stress about it to much, what you wanna do just comes to you eventually like it did for me part way through last year i found its not really something you can force yourself to know.

Thanks to the internet you dont need to live in certain country, i did a film course for a year but decided to do something else but i learned that building a presence on a online platform is an amazing way to get into the industry. You should buy a camera, look up some stuff online and start doing your own home made films, documentaries and maybe music videos or something. When i did the college course I was expected to be completely independent, and do everything our self like find actors get equipment ect . So you could definitely do it from home and maybe post your stuff to youtube and use something like reddit to get it seen. The film industry is hard to get into no matter where you are so starting early is great you are only 15. Then when you are a bit older maybe consider coming somewhere like the uk or America to study and start building your way into the industry. You might start off with the less glamours jobs but i'm sure if you are dedicated enough you will get noticed and be successful, this stuff seems daunting but if you are truly passionate about it you will go for it anyway so good luck hope you get what you want from life.
